promotionRules: Do not copy another repository wholesale into UIX-Apps.
Do not copy .git, node_modules, build output, archives, secrets, or local machine metadata.
Promote reviewed source as small docs, config, scripts, source-intake records, or UX Apps module changes.
Keep every promoted change scoped, reversible, and covered by a focused check.
When a source repo is dirty or remote auth is unavailable, record it as review-only until a clean handoff is chosen.
